name: AgentForge
mission: Inspectable software-engineering workflows with capability-scoped execution.
status: Initial implementation proposed on feature/capability-preview; independent review pending.
architecture: API and React dashboard after local execution contracts are proven
functional_requirements: Represent task dependencies and explicit terminal states
Deny undeclared tool capabilities by default
Record attempts, decisions, artifacts and failure classes
Bound execution time, output and retries
Support cancellation and replayable inspection without rerunning commands
phases: Sandbox adapter and subprocess isolation tests

backlog.title: Validate workflows and deny undeclared capabilities
backlog.problem: Agent tasks need enforceable execution boundaries before generated commands are allowed.
backlog.implementation: Pure task schema, explicit capability allowlist, state transition validation and redacted trace schema; no command runner in initial slice.
acceptance: Unknown capability or invalid transition fails closed
Trace cannot represent pending work as completed
Policy tests do not execute code or access network
tests: Deny default and conflicting capability cases
Cancellation, retry bounds and invalid state

testing_strategy: OS isolation integration tests before any generated-code runner
Frontend component/E2E tests once UI exists
release_criteria: No claim that policy validation alone is sandboxing
